name: Vegetable Tray
body:
Station and Complexity garde manger 1

Flavor Profiles bitter, salty, sour, spicy, or texture
Additional Ingredients salty, sour, sweet, or umami

EFFECT

Duration 1 minute/level; Serving Size 6

DESCRIPTION

This meal functions like prepared vegetables, except as noted here. If you have at least 1 lb. of vegetables, you can create a vegetable tray at any time without preparing it first, but the recipe must be in your cook book. 3 servings count as 1 good meal.

Additional salty or sour ingredients increase the duration to 1 hour/level.

Additional sweet and umami ingredients increase the serving size by +3 each.
